name: AROONUP
description: This keyword returns the AROON UP indicator value of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the AROON UP indicator value of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632223769.png)

The above keyword will return the previous day AROON UP value of ABFRL

The Aroon indicator is a technical indicator that is used to identify trend changes in the price of an asset, as well as the strength of that trend.

Learn more about Aroon here - https://www.investopedia.com/terms/a/aroon.asp
